items.problem: Migrated WinUI 3 app renders in the system-default (light) theme while the UWP golden renders dark. Cosmetic only; scoring marked it a non-defect.
items.evidence: discrepancies.json: single 'cosmetic' 'theme' discrepancy — 'Layout, controls, header, footer, and text all match. Not a functional defect.'; migration-score.json score 100.
items.covered_clearly_at: N/A — this is not a defect and not something the migration skill should force. Pinning RequestedTheme='Dark' to match a golden would be scenario-specific and wrong as a general rule (WinUI apps should follow the system theme). No skill change warranted.
items.why_no_skill_change: The scorer itself classified it cosmetic with no functional impact; forcing a dark theme to match one golden would be a scenario-specific anti-pattern, not a generalizable migration rule. Following the system theme is correct WinUI 3 behavior.
